sources.title: Weibel, An Introduction to Homological Algebra, Chapter 5
sources.locator: Printed pp.135–143, §5.5.1–11 and §5.6.1–2; pp.153–156, §5.8.7 and §5.9.1–4. PDF/browser extraction inspected, but several displayed equations in §5.5 are OCR-incomplete; no complete-reading claim for that unbounded proof.

contents.name: 5.5.3 Edge image
contents.support: Edge subobject/quotient logic used; the full general image statement remains in supplier page.

contents.name: Exercise 5.5.1 Homology need not be Hausdorff
contents.support: Local witnesses supplied; source exercise is not claimed as a supplied proof.

contents.name: 5.5.4 Nonconvergence example
contents.support: The manifest uses an independent explicit S -> P witness, not a transcription of the OCR-damaged integer formula.

contents.name: 5.5.5 Eilenberg–Moore filtration sequence
contents.support: Required mathematical input is UNRESOLVED, retained in the theorem escalation and proposed local tower inventory.

contents.name: 5.5.6 Hausdorff quotient corollary
contents.support: Part of unresolved convergence route, not asserted proved.

contents.name: 5.5.7 Actual cycles and filtered homology
contents.support: Actual versus limiting-cycle comparison requires tower proof; retained in escalation.

contents.name: 5.5.8 Boardman criterion
contents.support: Exact obstruction sequence required; OCR-incomplete formula not treated as a verified proof.

contents.name: Exercise 5.5.2 Equivalent image-tower criterion
contents.reason: The alternate R_p obstruction formulation is not used by the selected Q_p proof route; retaining it would duplicate an unneeded convergence criterion.

contents.name: Exercise 5.5.3 Vanishing and invisible homology
contents.support: The independent S -> P example calculates an invisible target directly.

contents.name: 5.5.9 Boardman double-tower vanishing
contents.support: Identified source dependency 5.8.7 is forward; local replacement not established.

contents.name: 5.5.10 Complete Convergence Theorem
contents.support: Both weak and bounded-above conclusions preserved with explicit source-regularity and AC; proof escalated.

contents.name: Exercise 5.5.4 Complete nonconverging spectral sequences
contents.reason: This stronger complete-but-nonseparated-homology example is additional source scope, beyond the requested exhaustive nonseparated B example. The source formulas need reliable full-text inspection and a separate checked witness before inclusion.

contents.name: 5.5.11 Eilenberg–Moore comparison without strong-convergence premises
contents.reason: This strengthens the design comparison hypothesis substantially; its cone proof also needs the unresolved full complete-convergence theorem. Preserve the result for owner scope reconciliation, not as an implicit premise.

contents.name: 5.6.1 Non-first-quadrant sum/product abutments
contents.reason: The assigned row/column theorems are first-quadrant. These additional quadrant-specific abutments need the unresolved complete branch and cannot be treated as proved illustrations.

contents.name: 5.6.3 Balancing Tor (adjacent result encountered)
contents.reason: Balanced Tor is a separate prerequisite-track application; no published-consumer repair or rebuilding of Tor is authorized in this batch.

contents.name: 5.6.4 Kunneth spectral sequence (adjacent result encountered)
contents.reason: This derived-computation application belongs to HA-17; it does not supply the local double-complex or exact-couple construction.

contents.name: 5.6.5 Kunneth formula and Exercise 5.6.1 UCT (adjacent results encountered)
contents.reason: The coefficient and Kunneth formulas are separate declared track interfaces, not additional claims of the present convergence machinery page.

contents.name: 5.6.6 Base-change for Tor (adjacent heading encountered)
contents.reason: The source argument was not completely inspected here; base-change computation is a later derived-functor application and is not consumed.

contents.name: 5.8.7 Lim-one of a double tower
contents.support: Dependency audit only: source uses 5.8.3 Grothendieck; proposed local Delta-bicomplex replacement is unresolved.

contents.name: 5.9.1 Exactness chase left to reader
contents.support: All three image-kernel chases are independently expanded in the manifest.

contents.name: 5.9.5–7 General exact-couple convergence (adjacent text encountered)
contents.reason: The assignment proves convergence for specified filtered complexes, not arbitrary AB5 exact couples with colimit targets; the extra colimit theorem is not a premise.

read_evidence.method: Browser full-text PDF extraction, with repeated range inspection
read_evidence.scope: Exact-couple definition, derivation, grading, filtered comparison and row/column constructions read; complete-convergence proof dependency path inspected through 5.8.7. Elementary missing diagram chases are supplied locally in manifest strategies.
read_evidence.limitation: No local full-text fetch stamp. Several convergence equations were not reliably extracted; this is one reason the unbounded proof stays escalated. Page/byte availability is not mathematical approval.

sources.title: The Stacks Project, Homological Algebra
sources.locator: Stacks §§12.18.1–7, 12.21.1–5, 12.24.1–11, 12.25.1–5; browser HTML full text. The corresponding monograph PDF is the retained unstamped original.

contents.name: 12.18.2 Tensor double complex
contents.reason: Tensoring resolutions and balanced-derived-functor proofs have separate track owners; the present examples use explicit finite abelian groups.

contents.name: 12.18.4 Triple complexes
contents.reason: The totalisation of three-variable complexes is not needed for the two-variable constructions; the proposed two-by-two Delta proof uses only a double complex.

contents.name: 12.18.5 Shifts and signs
contents.support: Sign discipline only; general two-shift compatibility is not an assigned theorem.

contents.name: 12.18.6–7 Totalisation and homotopies/split connecting maps
contents.reason: The current strict filtered-sequence compatibility uses LES naturality, not a totalisation homotopy or split connecting-morphism comparison.

contents.name: 12.21.5 Shift variant
contents.support: Bigraded degree data implemented explicitly, without summing objects.

contents.name: 12.24.1 Filtered complex
contents.support: Definition interface supplied by the current spectral-sequences items, which are draft; no already-published disposition used.

contents.name: 12.24.8 Stationarity equivalences
contents.support: Design two-sided terminology distinguished from the existing one-sided definition.

contents.name: 12.24.11(4) Weak Serre subcategory closure
contents.reason: This finiteness-property application needs a separate weak-Serre-category interface and is not a premise for any assigned convergence or comparison item.

contents.name: 12.24.12 Euler characteristic (adjacent heading encountered)
contents.reason: No Grothendieck-group Euler-characteristic formula is required for the selected pair; its proof was not fully harvested here.

contents.name: 12.25.3 Finite-diagonal convergence
contents.support: The finite biproduct isomorphism is proved locally; convergence uses the finite filtration theorem.

contents.name: 12.25.5 Totalisation of a horizontal homotopy equivalence
contents.reason: The assigned assembly proof uses finite spectral convergence and an explicit edge projection; the stronger homotopy-totalisation theorem is not invoked.

read_evidence.method: Browser HTML sections with explicit theorem/proof range inspection
read_evidence.scope: Definitions and displayed arguments inspected in 12.18, 12.21, 12.24 through 11 and 12.25. Source-omitted exact-couple and E-page chases are identified as omissions, supplied locally rather than claimed read.
read_evidence.limitation: PDF stamp failed. This is not an audit of all referenced earlier Stacks chapters or all published library ancestors.
